title: Tide and Summer
author: Jude Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Eastwick, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
